description: v2 capability tokens (rgt_vault.token). HMAC-SHA256 key is a FIXED TEST KEY, not a real secret. Wire: b64url(payload).b64url(hmac) without padding; payload = json.dumps(sort_keys, (',',':')) with ensure_ascii. token_id = sha256_hex(payload)[:16]. 'now' is the clock to inject for verify.

verify.name: keys_sorted_nested
verify.why: sort_keys at every level; true/null spelled as JSON

verify.name: unicode_ensure_ascii
verify.why: Python ensure_ascii: \u00e9, astral char as surrogate pair \ud83d\udd10. Go json.Marshal would NOT escape these

verify.name: html_chars_unescaped
verify.why: Python leaves < > & raw; Go json.Marshal would emit \u003c \u003e \u0026

verify.name: control_chars
verify.why: DEL (0x7f) IS escaped (\u007f) by Python ensure_ascii; '/' is not escaped

verify.name: big_int_binding
verify.why: above 2^53: a Go decoder into float64/any loses precision; use json.Number to re-sign byte-identically

verify.name: wrong_key
verify.why: valid HMAC under a different key

verify.name: embedded_newline_accepted
verify.why: non-alphabet chars are discarded by Python's non-strict b64decode

verify.why: int('abc') raises ValueError, NOT a TokenError
